analytics.description: Metrics computed right and what to track: events, tracking plans, UTMs, rates over matching windows. Use when a number looks off or tracking is being planned.

aso.description: Audit and improve an App Store or Google Play listing: title, subtitle, keywords, screenshots and ratings. Use when choosing listing text or images, or when downloads are low.
aso.guard: The project's own rules on what store copy may say (no competitor named, no AI mentioned, where it has such rules) win over anything below.

customer-research.description: What reviews, interviews and surveys really support, and how confidently. Use when mining reviews or feedback, or building personas.

debugging-and-error-recovery.description: Systematic root-cause debugging. Use when tests fail, a build breaks, something that worked has broken, or behaviour does not match what was expected.

expo-upgrade.description: Upgrade an Expo SDK version and fix the dependency issues it brings. Use when moving a project to a newer Expo SDK or when expo doctor reports mismatched packages.
expo-upgrade.guard: An SDK upgrade changes native code, so it ships in a store build and never as an over-the-air update. Re-check the project's patches and its local native modules against the new SDK, and follow the project's own release rules over anything below.

influencer-marketing.description: Paid creator and influencer partnerships: vetting, pay, rights, briefs, disclosure and payoff. Use when planning, paying for or judging a creator deal.
influencer-marketing.guard: In Russia a paid post needs an ERID from an ОРД, the «Реклама» label and the advertiser named, and paid advertising on Meta's platforms (Instagram, Facebook) is banned there since 1 September 2025. Check the market's own law before the payment and disclosure steps below: the FTC rules are the US's.

marketing-loops.description: A recurring marketing job an agent runs on a schedule: what it checks, acts on, remembers and when it stops. Use when automating a weekly or daily marketing check.

react-native-best-practices.description: React Native performance: FPS, startup time, bundle size, memory leaks, re-renders and animations. Use when a React Native screen is slow, janky or heavy, or when profiling one.
react-native-best-practices.guard: Measure before changing anything. A dependency suggested below (FlashList, the React Compiler, a native module) can change the native runtime: in a project that ships over-the-air updates it goes out only in a store build. The project's own release and design rules win over anything below.

reverse-engineer-marketing.description: How a competitor grew, from public evidence: their moves dated against traffic, reviews and funnel, then plays to run. Use when studying a competitor's growth.

security-and-hardening.description: Harden code against vulnerabilities. Use when handling user input, authentication, data storage or external integrations, or when auditing an input handler or a login flow.
security-and-hardening.guard: Rotating a leaked secret and purging history are the founder's: say what leaked and where.

video.description: Make video repeatably: clips rendered from data with Remotion or Hyperframes, product demos, AI generation and editing. Use when producing videos or choosing how to make them.
